archive.description: zip readable, member names unique, tileset.json parses as a tileset

skeleton.S4.description: explicit tiles with children have h >= 4; their non-leaf children with h < 4 are implicit roots; leaf children are explicit leaves; the root is the single implicit root iff h(root) < 4

documents.budget.description: every JSON document has <= 16,384 value nodes, <= 2 MiB and JSON depth <= 32

documents.levels.description: skeleton tiles sit at most 10 tile levels below their document root (links and unit children at most 11)

documents.compact.description: every tileset JSON document is compact JSON (no whitespace outside strings), so budgets are measured on compact bytes

links.wellFormed.description: link tiles: content.uri tileset-d{m}.json at the archive root, m = 1..D-1 each referenced by exactly one link, no children, no implicitTiling, doc root without transform and with children, doc asset/geometricError/extensionsUsed as specified

links.creationOrder.description: link numbers follow breadth-first order over documents taken in m order

P6.linkCoherence.description: a link tile's box, error and refine equal its document root's

P1.noJsonTemplate.description: no implicit root content template names a .json resource; the only tileset JSON documents are tileset.json and linked tileset-d{m}.json

P2.singleSubtreeRoots.description: every implicit root: subtreeLevels == availableLevels == h+1 <= 4, exactly one subtree member, childSubtreeAvailability {constant: 0}, no children, closed availability

P3.rowsEverywhere.description: every available tile has a FLOAT64 TILE_BOUNDING_BOX and TILE_GEOMETRIC_ERROR row; the level-0 row equals the root tile box and error

P4.namesClosed.description: distinct r{n} prefixes; every name a template produces for available content exists; every member is referenced; vector-build.json is bound by asset.extras.vectorBuildStateSha256

P10.slots.description: content layer count == template count; zero content means no content/contents and no contentAvailability; templates implicit-content/r{n}-{level}-{x}-{y}[-{z}]-{slot}.{glb|gltf|b3dm} in strictly sorted (slot, suffix) order, each with available content

P11.noImplicitChildIndex.description: no implicitChildIndex in any tile extras or row extras

P12.schema.description: tileset.json carries the rustyTilesImplicit schema iff an implicit root exists; every document holding one carries the same schema

PD11.noRetainedSources.description: no rustyTilesSourceContents anywhere; no unreferenced t/ member; implicit tiles never reference t/ members

payloads.wellFormed.description: implicit payloads are well-formed GLB (or b3dm-wrapped GLB); .gltf only at an implicit root

vectorBuild.reuseMap.description: when vector-build.json exists: its payloads map restores every entry byte-exactly to its sha256 key from a published implicit-content member

A4.tree.description: expanding every document and root yields exactly the tiles and parent/child relation of H

A4.roles.description: each tile has the role S = 4 assigns it in H

A4.explicitTiles.description: explicit tiles (and link + document root) equal the producer tile objects without children and implicitChildIndex; implicit roots carry the producer transform, box, error, refine and content headers

A4.rows.description: every row equals B(t) + delta(t) (delta summed parent-to-child in f64 from the implicit root) and e(t), bitwise; a row with delta = 0 is B(t) copied bit for bit

examples: tile p13: row extras differ in ['encodedBytes']
tile p17: row extras differ in ['encodedBytes']
tile p19: row extras differ in ['encodedBytes']
A4.extras.description: row extras equal the producer extras without implicitChildIndex; encodedBytes equals the published payload length

A4.payloads.description: explicit payloads byte-identical; implicit payloads: BIN chunk identical, JSON identical outside the scene-root node, root translation (or affine matrix column) == raw + (d0, d2, -d1) bitwise, root node text the only spliced span; a delta-0 payload is a byte copy; exactly one scene root, an affine matrix never combined with TRS

A4.names.description: each implicit root prefix r{n} is its preorder index in H

A4.contentUris.description: explicit tile content URIs equal the reference build URIs

A4.topLevel.description: tileset.json asset version, geometricError and extensionsUsed equal the reference build
